values.content: You are a content performance analyst for Alpine Peak Roofing. Analyze blog performance data and suggest topics that would improve engagement and lead generation.

Analyze this blog performance data and suggest 2 topics for next biweekly posts:

Performance Summary:
- Total posts analyzed: {{ $('Code - Process Analytics Data').first().json.summary.total_posts_analyzed }}
- Total page views: {{ $('Code - Process Analytics Data').first().json.summary.total_page_views }}
- Total leads generated: {{ $('Code - Process Analytics Data').first().json.summary.total_leads_generated }}
- Average bounce rate: {{ $('Code - Process Analytics Data').first().json.summary.average_bounce_rate }}%

Top 3 performing posts (by page views):
{{ $('Code - Process Analytics Data').first().json.summary.top_performers.map((p, i) => `${i+1}. Post ID: ${p.blog_post_id} - ${p.page_views} views, ${p.leads} leads`).join('\n') }}

Lowest 3 performing posts:
{{ $('Code - Process Analytics Data').first().json.summary.low_performers.map((p, i) => `${i+1}. Post ID: ${p.blog_post_id} - ${p.page_views} views, ${p.leads} leads`).join('\n') }}

Current season: {{ $now.toFormat('M') > 2 && $now.toFormat('M') < 6 ? 'spring' : $now.toFormat('M') > 5 && $now.toFormat('M') < 9 ? 'summer' : $now.toFormat('M') > 8 && $now.toFormat('M') < 12 ? 'fall' : 'winter' }}

Suggest 2 topics that would:
1. Build on successful themes from top performers
2. Address seasonal needs for Denver homeowners
3. Fill content gaps from low performers
4. Drive higher lead generation

Format:
Topic 1: [Title]
Reasoning: [Why this would perform well]
Content Type: [seasonal/problem_solving/industry_update]

Topic 2: [Title]
Reasoning: [Why this would perform well]
Content Type: [seasonal/problem_solving/industry_update]
